    Finite ideal lattices force primitive-projective Hom chains #

    For a split-basic finite-dimensional algebra, endpoint-stable subspaces of a primitive-projective Hom space embed into the ambient two-sided ideal lattice. If two such subspaces were incomparable, finite cover intervals and the split residue maps would produce a projective pencil indexed injectively by the ground field. An infinite field and a finite ideal lattice therefore force all endpoint-stable Hom subspaces to be comparable.
